questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Guru Nanak Dev Ji : Sikhism :: Gautam Buddha : ?
questions.exp: Guru Nanak Dev Ji founded Sikhism. Gautam Buddha founded Buddhism. Same founder-religion relationship.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A person walks 6km South, then 8km East. Find the distance from the starting point.
questions.exp: Using the 6-8-10 Pythagorean triplet: distance=√(6²+8²)=√(36+64)=√100=10km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Amritsar, Ludhiana, Patiala, Chandigarh
questions.exp: Amritsar, Ludhiana, and Patiala are cities within Punjab state. Chandigarh is a Union Territory and the shared capital — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 25 students, Manpreet is 9th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.exp: Position from right=Total+1-Position from left=26-9=17th.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If GURU is coded as HVSV, how is SEWA coded in the same pattern?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +1: G+1=H,U+1=V,R+1=S,U+1=V. Similarly S+1=T,E+1=F,W+1=X,A+1=B = TFXB.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: 36, 49, 64, 81, 90
questions.exp: 36=6², 49=7², 64=8², 81=9² — all perfect squares. 90 is not a perfect square — the odd one.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Guru Gobind Singh Ji founded the Khalsa Panth in which year?
questions.exp: Guru Gobind Singh Ji founded the Khalsa Panth on Baisakhi day, 1699, at Anandpur Sahib.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Sikh Guru compiled the Adi Granth?
questions.exp: Guru Arjan Dev Ji compiled the Adi Granth in 1604. Guru Gobind Singh Ji later added compositions and declared it the eternal Guru Granth Sahib.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Maharaja Ranjit Singh, founder of the Sikh Empire, was known as:
questions.exp: Maharaja Ranjit Singh was known as 'Sher-e-Punjab' (Lion of Punjab) for founding and expanding the Sikh Empire in 1799.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: The 'Golden Temple' (Harmandir Sahib) is located in which Punjab city?
questions.exp: The Golden Temple is located in Amritsar, built by Guru Arjan Dev Ji and considered the holiest Sikh shrine.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which river does NOT flow through Punjab?
questions.exp: Sutlej, Beas, and Ravi flow through Punjab. Yamuna does not flow through the state of Punjab.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A man buys a bicycle for ₹2400 and sells it at a loss of 15%. Find the selling price.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: Find the LCM of 14, 21, and 28.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with side 9cm?
questions.exp: Perimeter of equilateral triangle=3×side=3×9=27cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: If a train covers 360km in 6 hours, find its speed in km/h.
questions.exp: Speed=Distance/Time=360/6=60 km/h.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Synonym of HUMBLE:
questions.exp: Humble means having a modest or low estimate of one's own importance; not proud.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Antonym of DILIGENT:
questions.exp: Diligent means showing care and effort in work. Antonym = Lazy.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Fill in the blank: She ___ in Punjab for ten years.
questions.exp: Present Perfect tense is used for an action continuing from the past to the present: 'has lived for ten years'.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which is the state bird of Punjab?
questions.exp: The Baaz (Northern Goshawk) is the state bird of Punjab, holding special significance in Sikh tradition.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Lala Lajpat Rai, a key freedom fighter from Punjab, was popularly known as:
questions.exp: Lala Lajpat Rai was popularly known as 'Punjab Kesari' (Lion of Punjab) for his leadership in the freedom movement.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Bhagat Singh was hanged by the British on which date?
questions.exp: Bhagat Singh, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was hanged by the British on 23 March 1931 at Lahore Central Jail.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Punjab is often referred to as the 'Granary of India' due to its high production of:
questions.exp: Punjab is known as the 'Granary of India' for its high production of wheat and rice, especially after the Green Revolution of the 1960s.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Punjab festival marks the Sikh New Year and the formation of the Khalsa?
questions.exp: Baisakhi, celebrated on 13/14 April, marks the Sikh New Year and commemorates the formation of the Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh Ji in 1699.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.exp: Pattern: ×2+1 each time. 95×2+1=191.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Farmer : Plough :: Soldier : ?
questions.exp: A farmer uses a Plough as their primary tool. A soldier uses a Gun as their primary tool. Same worker-tool relationship.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If facing East and turning 90° anticlockwise twice, which direction will you face?
questions.exp: Facing East, turn 90° anticlockwise = North. Turn another 90° anticlockwise = West.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Wheat, Rice, Maize, Cotton
questions.exp: Wheat, Rice, and Maize are food/cereal crops. Cotton is a fibre crop, not a food crop — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is the mother of B. C is the brother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.exp: B and C are siblings (brother). A is B's mother, D is C's father. Since B and C share parents, A and D are husband and wife.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 22 people, P is 8th from the left and Q is 6th from the right. How many people are between P and Q?
questions.exp: Q's position from left=22-6+1=17. People between P(8th) and Q(17th)=17-8-1=8.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the missing term: D4, G7, J10, M13, ?
questions.exp: Letters skip 2 (D,G,J,M,P) and numbers increase by 3 (4,7,10,13,16). Answer=P16.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Who was the last Sikh Guru, and which eternal Guru did he establish?
opts: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, Adi Granth
Guru Gobind Singh Ji, Guru Granth Sahib
Guru Har Rai Ji, Dasam Granth
questions.exp: Guru Gobind Singh Ji was the 10th and last human Sikh Guru. Before his death in 1708, he declared the Guru Granth Sahib as the eternal Guru.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: The 'Jallianwala Bagh massacre' took place in which Punjab city?
questions.exp: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar, where General Dyer ordered firing on a peaceful gathering.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which is the largest city in Punjab by population?
questions.exp: Ludhiana is the largest city in Punjab by population, also serving as a major industrial and commercial hub.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Punjab's capital city, Chandigarh, was designed by which architect?
questions.exp: Chandigarh, the capital of Punjab (shared with Haryana), was designed by the renowned Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Punjab district is known for producing the most basmati rice?
questions.exp: Gurdaspur district is well known for high-quality basmati rice production in Punjab.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A and B together can complete a task in 9 days. If A alone can finish it in 15 days, how many days will B alone take?
questions.exp: Combined rate=1/9. A's rate=1/15. B's rate=1/9-1/15=5/45-3/45=2/45. B alone takes 45/2=22.5 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 8% per annum for 2 years.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: What is the surface area of a cube with side 6cm?
questions.exp: Surface area of cube=6×side²=6×36=216 cm².

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Synonym of COURAGEOUS:
questions.exp: Courageous means not deterred by danger or pain; brave.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Antonym of GENEROUS:
questions.exp: Generous means willing to give freely. Antonym = Stingy (unwilling to give or spend).

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Fill in the blank: The police ___ investigating the case for two weeks.
questions.exp: 'Police' is treated as a plural noun in English, so 'have been investigating' is correct.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Punjab freedom fighter is associated with the 'Komagata Maru' incident?
questions.exp: Gurdit Singh organized the Komagata Maru voyage (1914), carrying Indian immigrants who faced discrimination upon arrival in Canada.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Udham Singh assassinated which British official in 1940 in revenge for Jallianwala Bagh?
questions.exp: Udham Singh assassinated Michael O'Dwyer in London in 1940, who was responsible for the Jallianwala Bagh massacre as Lieutenant Governor of Punjab.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which gurdwara is known as the 'Golden Temple' of Sikh pilgrimage and also houses a free community kitchen?
questions.exp: Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) in Amritsar houses one of the world's largest free community kitchens (Guru Ka Langar), feeding thousands daily.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Punjab Police's official motto reflects which core values?
questions.exp: Punjab Police follows core values reflected in its commitment to 'Seva Suraksha' (Service and Security) to the people of the state.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which is the principal language and script used officially in Punjab?
questions.exp: Punjabi, written in the Gurmukhi script (invented by Guru Angad Dev Ji), is the official language of Punjab.
